title: How an order is handled
subtitle: From the first message to delivery
fallback_text: The bot checks stock, takes the order, and hands it to the owner to confirm before delivery.
source:
flowchart TD
  A[Customer asks] --> B{In stock?}
  B -- Yes --> C[Take the order]
  B -- No --> D[Offer another product]
  D --> B
  C --> E[Owner confirms]
  E --> F([Delivery])
